g.text: The material this site is made of, in one place:

538,063 bytes · 1,864 glyphs in two brands · offline browser, no permissions.

reads the files you hand it.
One palette, measured from the frame
The same four values are in
resources, and the band's geometry comes from the Figma frame that
started this: a 96px band, a 45px mark, 26px page name, 17px lines.
